results.title: Tian–Yuan–Zhang's row 5b
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: *Tian–Yuan–Zhang's row 5b* is the following assertion. For every natural number $d$ with $d\equiv5\pmod8$, $d$ squarefree and genus sum of class numbers $T^{\rm Cl}_{5b}(d)=1$ in $\mathbb Z/2$, there is an entire continuation $F$ of $L(C_d,s)$ whose order of vanishing at $s=1$ is at most $1$.

results.title: Gross–Zagier: a simple zero gives a point of infinite order
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The *Gross–Zagier statement* is the following assertion. Let $E$ be a Weierstrass equation over $\mathbb Q$ with nonzero discriminant, that is, an elliptic curve over $\mathbb Q$ (the equation need not be minimal), and let $F$ be an entire continuation of $L(E,s)$. If the order of vanishing of $F$ at $s=1$ is exactly $1$, then $E(\mathbb Q)$ has a point of infinite order.

results.title: The functional equation gives vanishing at the centre
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The functional equation of $L(C_d,s)$ on the critical strip implies vanishing at the centre: if for every squarefree natural number $d\equiv5\pmod8$, every entire continuation $F$ of $L(C_d,s)$ and every $s$ with $0<\operatorname{Re}s<2$ one has $\Lambda_{32d^2}(2-s)=-\Lambda_{32d^2}(s)$, then $F(1)=0$ for every such $d$ and $F$.

results.title: Analytic rank one for the curves of row 5b
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Assume Tian–Yuan–Zhang's row 5b and vanishing at the centre. Let $d$ be a natural number with $d\equiv5\pmod8$, $d$ squarefree and $T^{\rm Cl}_{5b}(d)=1$. Then $L(C_d,s)$ has an entire continuation whose order of vanishing at $s=1$ is exactly $1$.

results.title: Row 5b, vanishing at the centre and Gross–Zagier give CR₃^TYZ_Cl,Rk
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Tian–Yuan–Zhang's row 5b, vanishing at the centre and the Gross–Zagier statement together imply the class-number hypothesis in positive-rank form CR₃^TYZ_Cl,Rk: for every natural number $d$ with $d\equiv5\pmod8$, $d$ squarefree and $T^{\rm Cl}_{5b}(d)=1$, the curve $C_d$ has a rational point of infinite order.

results.title: The first genus sum $T^{\rm Cl}_{5a}$
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number. For a set $B$ of primes of $d$ write $d_B=\prod_{p\in B}p$. A set partition $\pi$ of the primes of $d$ is *admissible for row 5a* if exactly one block $B$ of $\pi$ has $d_B\equiv5\pmod8$ and every block $B$ of $\pi$ has $d_B\equiv5$ or $d_B\equiv1\pmod8$.
